parameters.message:
Available commands:
register - create an account
login - sign in
settings - view your settings
topics - update your interests
schedule - update delivery time
email - update your email
logout - sign out
subscribe - enable newsletters
unsubscribe - disable newsletters
delete account - delete your data
cancel - cancel the current action
